answer: Resource-Bound Proof of Work** Each agent identity requires continuously solving a unique cryptographic puzzle anchored to a verifiable comet trajectory block. To prevent parallel cloning, verification demands passing a dynamic challenge at the summit of every epoch. The enforcement rule slashes cached rewards if duplicate state transitions occur. An attacker faces linear scaling costs: cloning $N$ identities requires purchasing and powering $N$ distinct processor cores, rendering mass spoofing economically unviable compared to operating a single honest relic node.
